specs.source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/screens/01-dashboard.png (artboard image is the authority per SETUP); dc.html id="p1"; README screen 1
notes: Region-composition check, not a value check (page-frame.json and the per-part specs already check exact colours/type/spacing). This spec checks that the artboard's regions exist, in the artboard's top-to-bottom order, inside `[data-audit="dashboard"]` — the real DashboardBrief mounted by page-frame-1440.

The masthead (VOL line, title, dek, command bar) is NOT inside this mount (page-frame-1440 wraps DashboardBrief only, no DashboardMasthead) — verified separately by source read of src/app/page.tsx + src/components/dashboard/DashboardMasthead.tsx and the live-server screenshot docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/built/uxfix-5.1-4.1-4.2-5.2-2.1-2.2-dashboard.png. A follow-up mount that adds DashboardMasthead (stubbing useAuth/useWorkspaceStore/useWorkspaceBootstrap) would let this spec check the masthead region too.

Artboard order top to bottom: band tiles (Immediate/Action/Monitor/Awareness) -> Due next card (heading, column header, rows, foot 'All N immediate' / 'then N action . N monitor') -> What changed card (heading, column header, rows, foot) -> rail (Across the platform, Watchlist, Legend), rail running alongside the two left-column cards, not below them.
Due-next foot's 'All N immediate' is a real link to /regulations?band=immediate per operator ruling 1.1 (closed) — checked below as an <a>/Link element, not plain text.

ITEM F2 (operator, 2026-09-08): "'Due next' and 'What changed' must use the same row component as the lists (B), including 56px rows and the overflow cell." They already do on this base — DashboardBrief.tsx imports ListRow/ListRowColumnHeader and renders no row markup of its own — so nothing was rebuilt; the rows below MEASURE it on the real dashboard tree so the claim is evidence rather than a source read, and so a future page-local table would fail here.

children.name: region 1 — band tiles row (Immediate, Action, Monitor, Awareness, in that order)
children.note: Live band-count numerals (14/31/1135/254 in the seeded fixture) are checked by bandtile.json; this row only checks the region exists in the grid.

children.name: region 2 — Due next card, comes after band tiles, before What changed
children.note: Text is 'Due next · N items' where N is the live due-next row count, not a fixed artboard string.

children.name: region 2a — Due next foot 'All N immediate' is a real link (ruling 1.1)
region 3 — What changed card, comes after Due next
region 4 — rail, 'Across the platform' card first
region 5 — rail, Watchlist card second
region 6 — rail, Legend card third and last
F2 — the dashboard's tables render through the shared ListRow, at the list row's own 56px and grid
children.note: Same values listrow.json asserts on the component in isolation, asserted here on the assembled dashboard so 'the dashboard uses the same row' is measured, not assumed. B6's grid and 56px are the operator's own numbers.

children.name: F2 — and each of those rows carries the 44px overflow cell with its 1px rgba(0,0,0,.08) left divider
children.note: F2: 'including ... the overflow cell'. The 44px cell width is asserted by the grid track above; this is the divider that makes it read as a cell. The CONTROL inside it was missing until this round: the dashboard passed no `overflow`, so artboard 1's own row-end glyph was absent on both tables while the cell and its divider rendered. It now mounts the same PriorityDropdown+WatchButton the five list surfaces mount.

children.name: F2 — the column header row is unchanged, 9.5px uppercase .12em
children.note: F2: 'The column header row (JURIS. / TITLE / IMPACT LOW->H / DUE / TIMELINE / TIER) is correct; keep it, 9.5px uppercase .12em.' Asserted so 'keep it' is enforced rather than trusted.

children.name: B7 — the band spine is 3px, full-bleed, flush to the card's left edge
children.note: B7: 'Band spine is 3px full-bleed, flush to the card's left edge — correct.' Verified, not rebuilt: 3px wide, the row's own padding-left is 0 (asserted above), so the spine starts at the card's inner edge.

children.name: F2 — the dashboard's rows end in the same bare 28px ⋯ glyph the list surfaces use
children.note: Artboard 1 draws the ⋯ on both dashboard tables. B2's geometry, measured here on the dashboard so 'the same control' is a measurement rather than a claim.

forbid.name: no floating Ask AI button (ruling 2.2)
forbid.reason: The masthead command bar's 'Ask' is the only ask surface sitewide; a second floating control is a dead-region violation per ruling 2.2.

forbid.name: row impact meter never renders bare '0' for an unscored item (ruling: never 0)
forbid.reason: An unscored row's impact cell must render ImpactMeter's dashed baseline + Absence reason, never a fabricated zero score. The regex form is deliberate: a plain "0/12" substring also matches the legitimate "10/12", which made this forbid report a passing product as a defect.

forbid.name: D-M4: no list row carries more than one absence token
forbid.reason: D-M4 (operator mobile report 2026-09-08) [CONFIRMED at 1440 and at 390]. The impact, due and tier cells each rendered their own <Absence>, so a row missing all three drew a dashed baseline plus UNSCORED plus PENDING plus NOT IN PRIMARY SOURCE — three tokens, the third on a line of its own. Ruling 2.1 allows exactly ONE reason per row. This selector matches a row carrying a token in TWO of the three cells, which is the defect and nothing else. The structural guarantee is ListRow's `reasonSlot`.

`compiledCss: true` is required here and on every mobile-* spec: AppShell/Sidebar/TopBar express the desktop/mobile switch as Tailwind utility classes (`hidden md:flex`, `md:hidden`), which the raw globals.css read every other spec uses leaves un-expanded. The drawer is closed in this mount (AppShell's own initial state), so DRAWER geometry is measured by mobile-18-drawer.json, which opens it.

Top bar hamburger: 44x44 target, glyph 17px

children.name: D-M1: band tiles are two columns at 390, on every surface that renders them

boundsCheck.name: no top-bar cell overlaps a sibling or escapes the 56px bar at 390

boundsCheck.reason: Same defect class at the narrowest supported width: 375 must not clip, so 390 must have headroom.

boundsCheck.name: nothing inside the brief escapes the 390 viewport
boundsCheck.reason: MOBILE-60 regression guard: the four fixes above (brief track floor, column header, section head, card foot) each showed up first as a child wider than its own container at 390. Operator standard 2026-09-07: 'a visual pass for overflow/collision/orphan lines on every page'.
